title: A command that was abandoned and then completed is read as one whose start was never told, and fences other sessions' carried gates
outcome: The end of a command whose start the host was told, but whose key it has since dropped (abandoned, as a declined Codex command is; evicted past the running-command limit; or cleared by a turn start), is not classified as a command whose start was never reported.
acceptance: A command whose start was truly never reported still fences where its session writes; the existing test for it passes unchanged.
A test reports a command's start, abandons it, then reports its completion under the same key, in a session other than the holder of a carried gate: the carried check is not fenced by the completion.
The full gate passed on the exact landed input.
